description: Request an AnyForge review of an existing pull request: the same review that commenting "@anyforge review" on it produces and posts on the PR. No crew, work item or initiative is needed, and nothing is merged, approved or pushed. Returns as soon as the review is queued (queued: true); the review covers the PR head at the time it runs. If the PR already has a review for its current head, the existing review's status is returned (queued: false) and no second review is posted. Refused with a stated reason when: the caller is not an owner or operator, the caller has not connected GitHub, the workspace setting "Review pull requests opened outside AnyForge" is off, the repository is not connected, the PR is unknown, a draft, closed or opened by AnyForge or one of its crews, or a per-PR or daily review limit is reached. Requires write scope and a key that belongs to a person.

repo.description: The repository as owner/name, for example acme/api.
